description.value: The Cranberry Arms is a historic neighbourhood pub and hotel in Cedar, south of Nanaimo, with roots going back to 1878 when the property was won in a card game by Irish immigrants. Newly renovated rooms sit above a lively community pub that hosts regular events including karaoke, sports nights, and charity fundraisers. The hotel offers five rooms ranging from a full suite with kitchen to standard queen rooms, and a shared non-smoking balcony for guests.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and provides address (1604 Cedar Rd, Nanaimo BC V9X 1L2), phone (250-722-3112), and operational details confirming the business is active. The hotel page describes 5 newly renovated rooms with TV, fridge, and coffee maker, but there is no mention of bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site. The on-site pub and restaurant confirm evening food is available at the same location.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id, no address, and no phone — all contact details sourced entirely from the website.
Website hotel page still references a COVID-19 Safety Plan link, suggesting some content may be dated, though business appears fully operational.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational pub and hotel with an active website, confirmed address and phone, and rooms available to book. Clear value to touring cyclists as overnight accommodation with on-site food.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site restaurant and pub serves food and drinks daily; testimonials mention brunch, wing nights, and curries
